item.title: Pretty Fry For A French Guy
item.description: Read Pretty Fry For A French Guy Customer: *To my manager.* "Are your French fries made from real potatoes?" My manager looks at the 50 Lb sacks of potatoes that the customer is standing next to, and the large sign on the wall stating the name and location of the farm where today's potatoes have been sourced from. He then turns back to the customer. Read Pretty Fry For A French Guy

item.title: Measure For Measure, You’re An Idiot
item.description: Read Measure For Measure, You’re An Idiot Me: "Could I have two gin and tonics, please?" Server: "Of course!" The server grabs a glass and immediately pours a double measure in. Me: "I only wanted them singles." Read Measure For Measure, You’re An Idiot

item.title: This Is Not How We Roll
item.description: Read This Is Not How We Roll Customer: "So, can I get some free plays?" Me: "You can get free drinks, but nothing to do with the actual game." Customer: "I thought this was the player's club desk?" Read This Is Not How We Roll

item.title: Their Claims To Know What They’re Doing Is Doing A Lot Of Heavy Lifting
item.description: Read Their Claims To Know What They’re Doing Is Doing A Lot Of Heavy Lifting Supervisor: "Oh! Oh no! My leg!" Customer: "What?!" The customer runs around the trolley to see my supervisor on the floor… with one leg missing. Read Their Claims To Know What They’re Doing Is Doing A Lot Of Heavy Lifting
